evidence.ran: bash .loop/verify.sh (fast shell suites incl. autoloop-inbox, which applies the same edit/skip/first shapes at lines 34, 36, 57 + claude plugin test mods/bussin-loop-status: 50 pass, new test 'a task that has not started offers Edit, Do it next and Skip it, each writing one inbox change' on terminal, desktop and mobile)

notes:
Did: the open box of a pending task (failing, ready or waiting) shows Edit, Do it next (first-<id>) and Skip it (skip-<id>). Edit (edit-<id>, left out where there is no Input) swaps the Done when line for two Inputs edit-plain-<id> / edit-done-<id> (rows 2) with Save / Cancel; the typed text lives in editDraftAtom ({key, plain, doneWhen}, added to types PluginState), and pressing any task drops the draft. sendChange() writes <loop>/.loop/inbox/<clock ms>-<12 hex from crypto.randomUUID>.json with JSON.stringify(change) + newline, then toasts '<what>. Applied before the next task starts.'; a failed write toasts the error and leaves the edit open. Save trims both fields and refuses an empty plain sentence with a toast. answerLogged in the tests now takes an optional toasts array.
Learned: at runtime the mobile surface's element table still contains Input and draws it as an empty Box, so `'Input' in elements` is true on mobile; the pane now also checks e.surface !== 'mobile' (this also makes Rename on mobile show the terminal hint instead of an empty field). $.fs.write creates missing parent folders, so no mkdir is needed for .loop/inbox. jq -f is denied in unattended sessions, so feeding a file through inbox.jq by hand is not possible there; tests/autoloop-inbox.test.sh is the way. F7 can reuse sendChange() for its add change (it takes Record<string, string>; widen the type for metrics).
Lesson: [plugin-authoring] the mobile mount still drew Edit because 'Input' in $.ui.resolve(e) is true on mobile at runtime despite the typed table → gate text fields on e.surface !== 'mobile' as well, and test a mobile mount for every Input-based control.
Lesson: [tests] review found the done task was checked only for Edit and toasts were counted across surfaces → assert every control the spec forbids, and compare toasts exactly per surface.
